check_count_definition: One unique executable scoped check unit; vector/output comparisons within a unit are separately counted as raw evidence values, not inflated into unit count.

baselines.boundary: frozen public spec/contract/seed baseline constructor only; no DUT execution

port_feedback.boundary: Frozen helper reused over saved execution objects; equality to stored trace and delivered STATE checked. Not an independent replacement helper or new DUT run.

accounting.boundary: Ledger arithmetic/reservation formula and reported usage totals checked; request-body order attestation handled by separate trace review.

requests.request_sha_boundary: Ledger SHA is canonical sorted JSON payload, not an attestation of network byte field ordering.

history.history_scope: Accounting/closed flag and preregistered membership only; no historical score selection.

limitations: Same-team internally controlled synthetic module-set holdout; no external blindness, independent human review or pretraining novelty claim.
Frozen built-in reference, generator, summary and feedback helper reused purely over saved evidence; no new simulator execution and no independent replacement oracle.
Canonical sorted ledger payload SHA does not prove network JSON field order, provider internals or currency billing.
Functional coverage for both new modules is unsupported with no bins; no coverage-gain claim.
Separate entry-author trace audit has a different reviewer; this core audit is still AI machine review, not human H02.
Preregistered style failures and missing WaveDrom renderer remain; successful functional evidence does not clear those gates.

final_command_and_observation_bindings.scope: Supplement checks saved compile/run argv, simulator source metadata and complete observed packet provenance. No source changes or new execution.

audit_attempt_explanation.r1: Auditor compared raw unnormalized source contract to normalized runtime contract, and regenerated TB from sorted pipeline JSON instead of original testplan dictionary order. r2 fixes those assumptions, exact original testplan rendering and all evidence checks pass. Dependent detection/denominator errors were auditor effects; r1 is retained.
audit_attempt_explanation.r2: Full 108-row/268-side saved evidence core audit passed all 1923 unique scoped units.
audit_attempt_explanation.r3_r4_r5: Supplement incorrectly assumed passed-only status; then premature repairs inferred failed raw status or passed=false. Frozen actual records instead use passed_with_warnings/passed=true with failed_checks verdict for genuine wrong output. All three 269-unit attempts and premature notes are retained and superseded by r6; no experiment bytes changed.
audit_attempt_explanation.r6: Correct framework status relationship and full saved compile/run argv, observed packet metadata/provenance all pass: 268 sides plus one unchanged-source/artifact closure check.

tool_binding_scope: All own tools, helpers, correction notes, source originals, attempt receipts, logs and intermediate core JSON files existing at finalization. The separate seal receipt binds this final core and artifact-bindings manifest without recursive self-hashing.
execution_status_boundary: Completed execution can be passed_with_warnings while verdict=failed_checks and true output mismatch records exist; wrong-output detection is counted only with the identical-stimulus correct replay passed.
terminal_failure_boundary: One feedback task ended decision_format_error after a completed 14-cycle DUT/replay episode and three charged requests. It is retained as a failed detection in the 12-defect denominator. Strict evidence qualification does not mean all request formats succeeded.
reviewer_role: AI non-implementer core evidence audit; did not write this round Agent, assets, entry or production configuration. Separate entry-author trace audit is not counted here; neither is human H02.
